steps.label: stills
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/ship/"* . && rm -f st_*.jpg; for s in sea_track sea_top sea_sunset port crank_a stern_prop holo_reveal; do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P ship3d.py -- $s still 50 > st_$s.log 2>&1; grep -a "SHIP3D" st_$s.log | cut -c1-600; tail -4 st_$s.log > tail_$s.txt; done; a=""; for f in st_*.jpg tail_*.txt; do a="$a $f ship/st1/$f"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2
